description: Write, validate and preview DESIGN.md design system files
config.validate.enable: Validate DESIGN.md files with the official @google/design.md linter.
config.validate.contrastRatio: Warn when a component's textColor and backgroundColor fall below the WCAG AA contrast ratio of 4.5:1.
config.validate.debounceMs: Delay in milliseconds before re-validating after an edit.
